environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB configured with a mutual TLS listener (mTLS). The ALB trust store references an internal ACM Private CA (subordinate CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890). The listener's MutualAuthentication mode is set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough'), meaning the ALB terminates connections that do not present a valid client certificate signed by the specified CA chain BEFORE forwarding to the target group. Client certificates are issued only to internal service accounts via an automated PKI enrollment pipeline with 24-hour validity. The target group health check path is /health and only the ALB security group (sg-0abc123def456) is permitted inbound on port 8080 to the ECS tasks. No direct network path exists to the application containers.

alb_mutual_tls.ca_chain: Internal ACM PCA subordinate CA, 2048-bit RSA, CRL distribution enabled

network.ecs_security_group: Inbound only from ALB SG sg-0abc123def456 on port 8080

container.runtime: Fargate, read-only root filesystem except /tmp and /var/www/storage

config.certificate_issuance: Automated via internal PKI, only to service accounts in IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/internal-service-client
